theme: Travel day — the long way home from Croatia lands in Tampa.
greeting: Welcome back, Dan. Two flights and a Frankfurt connection carry you home this afternoon, wheels down at Tampa just before four. Before the jet lag lands too, the car and a bed for tonight are the two things worth locking down.

needsAttention.title: Rental car waiting at Tampa
needsAttention.detail: The full-size SUV for TPA Sept 20 to Oct 5 needs to be booked before you're at the counter, jet-lagged, on a Sunday. It's the car for the whole span, including the Orlando drive. (Travel, due Sept 9.)

needsAttention.title: Two nights in St. Pete before pickup
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20 to 22 landing gap is the last open piece of lodging — somewhere near St. Pete for tonight and tomorrow, since the girls aren't picked up until Tuesday at 3 PM. (Travel, overdue.)

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV out of Portland
needsAttention.detail: A refundable full-size SUV from PWM over Christmas week is the thinnest rental in that market and sells out early — booking it refundable now costs nothing and closes the risk. (Travel, overdue Sept 14.)

schedule.title: Flight Frankfurt to Tampa
schedule.detail: The last leg home; lands TPA 3:55 PM

inbox.noise: About twenty unread, all newsletters and receipts — NYT Cooking, WSJ, Field Company, Chairish, and a Booking.com rate request from the hotel you just left.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Ginger spice cake with dried cherries
recipe.why: Autumn calls for warm spice and dried fruit as the orchard fruit fades.

tasks.title: Plan a grocery stop before the Orlando villa
Buy Disney park tickets for the 26th to 27th

acts.line: Cavtat to Dubrovnik before dawn, then Frankfurt — the trip home is really the whole morning.
Wheels down at Tampa just before four, with the car and a room the first things to sort.
A quiet first night back in St. Pete; the girls come Tuesday, so tonight is yours to reset.
